stations.title: Bridie
stations.note: A copied ticket got on twice.

stations.title: Gangway scanner
stations.text: Beeps at every ticket, and forgets it

stations.title: Gangway
stations.note: The copy is caught at the gangway.

captions: The gangway. Bridie wants to know when a ticket is scanned a second time.
Today the scanner forgets every ticket, so a copied one walks on twice.
You keep sets: tickets scanned twice, names seen both days, and the free seats.
Now a second scan of T-41 is caught before anyone boards.
Every ticket remembered, once. Next: a noticeboard in the right order.
